senses.en: to want a particular amount of money for something
senses.pattern: ask $500 for sth / ask a high price / ask too much for sth
senses.example: The seller is [[asking]] eight thousand dollars for the used scooter, but I think it is worth half.
senses.example_zh: 賣家對這輛二手機車開價八千元，但我覺得它只值一半。
senses.note: asking price 即「開價」

senses.en: to expect or demand something from someone
senses.pattern: ask a lot of sb / ask too much of sb / be too much to ask
senses.example: The coach [[asks]] a great deal of her swimmers, who train twice a day even in winter.
senses.example_zh: 教練對她的游泳選手要求很高，他們連冬天也一天訓練兩次。
senses.note: 句型為 ask sth of sb

senses.en: a large formal party with dancing
senses.pattern: a charity ball / a masked ball / attend a ball
senses.example: Every guest at the charity [[ball]] wore a formal gown or suit and danced until midnight.
senses.example_zh: 慈善舞會上的每位賓客都穿著正式禮服或西裝，一直跳舞到午夜。
senses.note: have a ball 指「玩得很開心」

senses.en: not noticing or refusing to notice something
senses.pattern: be blind to the risks / be blind to one's faults / turn a blind eye to
senses.example: Many parents are [[blind]] to their own children's faults and blame the school for every problem.
senses.example_zh: 許多父母對自己孩子的缺點視而不見，把所有問題都怪到學校頭上。
senses.note: 名詞 blinds 指「百葉窗」

senses.en: to stop someone from thinking or judging clearly
senses.pattern: be blinded by love / be blinded by anger / blind sb to the truth
senses.example: The company's early success [[blinded]] its managers to the fact that customers' tastes were changing.
senses.example_zh: 公司早期的成功蒙蔽了經理人，使他們看不出顧客的喜好正在改變。

senses.en: to praise or honor someone or something publicly
senses.pattern: celebrate the beauty of / celebrate diversity / be celebrated for
senses.example: Many of her poems [[celebrate]] the simple beauty of village life and the courage of ordinary farmers.
senses.example_zh: 她的許多詩作歌頌鄉村生活的樸實之美，以及平凡農民的勇氣。
senses.note: celebrated（adj.）著名的

senses.en: a hard building material made from cement, sand, stones, and water
senses.pattern: reinforced concrete / pour concrete / a concrete wall / concrete blocks
senses.example: Workers poured wet [[concrete]] into the wooden frames to form the foundation of the new library.
senses.example_zh: 工人把濕混凝土灌入木模，打造新圖書館的地基。
senses.note: 不可數；也可作形容詞「混凝土製的」

gsat.sentence: Today, spiral staircases come in a wide variety of materials: steel, wood, [[concrete]], and recently even glass.

The new development has several important features: use of wind and solar energy, passive heating and cooling systems, as well as [[concrete]] runways in place of asphalt, which has a greater carbon footprint during its production cycle.

senses.en: not friendly; showing little interest or warmth
senses.pattern: a cool reception / a cool response / be cool toward sb
senses.example: Ever since their argument, Mia has been [[cool]] toward her old friend and rarely speaks to her.
senses.example_zh: 自從那次爭吵後，米亞對老朋友一直很冷淡，很少跟她說話。

senses.en: calm; not excited, nervous, or angry
senses.pattern: stay cool / keep cool / a cool head / cool under pressure
senses.example: The pilot stayed [[cool]] during the emergency and landed the plane safely on a small airfield.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員在緊急狀況中保持冷靜，讓飛機安全降落在一座小機場。
senses.note: 名詞用法：keep / lose one's cool

senses.en: to make someone lose something valuable
senses.pattern: cost sb their life / cost sb the job / cost sb the game
senses.example: Arriving twenty minutes late for the final interview [[cost]] Jason the job he had always wanted.
senses.example_zh: 最後一輪面試遲到二十分鐘，使傑森失去了他夢寐以求的工作。
senses.note: 三態同形：cost-cost-cost

senses.en: the loss or harm suffered in order to gain something
senses.pattern: at the cost of / at all costs / at great cost
senses.example: The factory increased its profits, but only at the [[cost]] of the health of nearby residents.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠增加了獲利，卻是以附近居民的健康為代價。

gsat.sentence: They had to learn from their own mistakes, which [[cost]] some their lives, and almost all suffered light or severe injuries.
Still, many animal rights activists believe the [[cost]] of confining animals outweighs the benefits.

senses.en: annoyed or slightly angry
senses.pattern: be cross with someone / get cross about / a cross look
senses.example: Mom was [[cross]] with my brother because he had left his muddy shoes on the sofa.
senses.example_zh: 媽媽很生我弟弟的氣，因為他把沾滿泥巴的鞋子留在沙發上。
senses.note: 多見於英式英語；be cross with＋人

senses.en: a mixture of two different things or breeds
senses.pattern: a cross between A and B / a cross between two breeds / a poodle cross
senses.example: The fruit looks like a [[cross]] between a lemon and an orange and tastes surprisingly sweet.
senses.example_zh: 這種水果看起來像是檸檬和柳橙的混合體，嚐起來出奇地甜。

senses.en: to reduce the amount, size, or cost of something
senses.pattern: cut costs / cut prices / cut jobs / cut spending
senses.example: To [[cut]] costs, the company asked its employees to hold online meetings instead of flying abroad.
senses.example_zh: 為了削減成本，公司要求員工改開線上會議，不再搭機出國。
senses.note: 名詞 cut：budget cuts 預算刪減

senses.en: to stay away from a class on purpose
senses.pattern: cut class / cut school / cut a lecture
senses.example: He was punished for [[cutting]] math class twice last week to play basketball in the park.
senses.example_zh: 他上週兩次蹺數學課去公園打籃球，因此受到處罰。
senses.note: 美式口語；亦說 skip class

senses.en: completely; exactly
senses.pattern: dead right / dead tired / dead serious / stop dead
senses.example: You were [[dead]] right about the weather; it started pouring just after we left.
senses.example_zh: 關於天氣你說得完全正確；我們一出門就下起了傾盆大雨。
senses.note: 口語用法，置於形容詞或副詞前

senses.en: (of a machine or battery) no longer working or having power
senses.pattern: a dead battery / the phone went dead / the line is dead
senses.example: My phone battery was [[dead]], so I couldn't call my parents to pick me up.
senses.example_zh: 我的手機電池沒電了，所以沒辦法打電話請爸媽來接我。
senses.note: go dead＝突然斷電、斷線

senses.en: flat and smooth; steady and regular
senses.pattern: an even surface / even ground / at an even pace
senses.example: Make sure the floor is [[even]] before you lay the tiles, or they may crack later.
senses.example_zh: 鋪磁磚之前要確認地面是平坦的，否則磁磚日後可能會裂開。
senses.note: even number＝偶數；odd number＝奇數

senses.en: equal in amount, level, or strength
senses.pattern: an even contest / an even distribution / an even chance
senses.example: It was such an [[even]] contest that nobody could predict the winner until the final minute.
senses.example_zh: 這場比賽雙方勢均力敵，直到最後一分鐘都沒人能預測誰會贏。
senses.note: 副詞 evenly＝平均地

senses.en: to make or become equal or level
senses.pattern: even out / even the score / even things up
senses.example: A late goal [[evened]] the score, and the crowd jumped to their feet in excitement.
senses.example_zh: 比賽尾聲的一記進球把比數拉平，觀眾興奮得跳了起來。
senses.note: 常作 even out／even up

gsat.sentence: To [[even]] things out, the body will get rid of water by producing urine.

senses.en: to officially submit a complaint, request, or legal case
senses.pattern: file a lawsuit / file a complaint / file a patent / file a report
senses.example: Several customers [[filed]] a complaint after the airline lost their luggage for a week.
senses.example_zh: 航空公司把行李弄丟一週後，數名顧客提出了申訴。

senses.en: to walk in a line, one behind another
senses.pattern: file into the hall / file out of the room / file past
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the students [[filed]] quietly out of the classroom.
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，學生們排成縱隊安靜地走出教室。
senses.note: in single file＝排成一路縱隊

gsat.sentence: Patents with innovations on Knight’s ideas were [[filed]] nationwide.
One can [[file]] a lawsuit in court.

senses.en: the bottom of the sea, a valley, or a forest
senses.pattern: the ocean floor / the sea floor / the forest floor / the valley floor
senses.example: Using a robot camera, scientists discovered strange glowing fish near the ocean [[floor]].
senses.example_zh: 科學家利用機器人攝影機，在接近海洋底部的地方發現了奇特的發光魚類。
senses.note: 另：take the floor（在會議中）發言

senses.zh: 使驚訝得說不出話；難倒
senses.en: to surprise or confuse someone completely
senses.pattern: be floored by / completely floor sb / floor sb with a question
senses.example: The interviewer's last question completely [[floored]] me, and I sat there in silence.
senses.example_zh: 面試官的最後一個問題讓我驚訝得說不出話，只能呆坐在那裡。
senses.note: 常用被動 be floored by

senses.en: to understand an explanation, argument, or story
senses.pattern: follow an explanation / follow the plot / hard to follow / Do you follow me?
senses.example: The professor spoke so fast that few students could [[follow]] his explanation.
senses.example_zh: 教授講得太快，很少學生能聽懂他的解釋。

senses.en: to be the logical result of something
senses.pattern: it follows that… / it doesn't follow that… / follow from sth
senses.example: Just because a product is expensive, it does not [[follow]] that it is good.
senses.example_zh: 一項產品價格昂貴，並不能由此推知它的品質一定好。

senses.en: to prevent a plan or effort from succeeding
senses.pattern: frustrate a plan / frustrate an attempt / frustrate someone's efforts
senses.example: Heavy rain [[frustrated]] the rescuers' attempts to reach the climbers trapped near the summit.
senses.example_zh: 大雨阻撓了搜救人員的行動，使他們無法抵達受困在山頂附近的登山客身邊。

senses.en: a good reason for doing or believing something
senses.pattern: on the grounds that / on medical grounds / grounds for complaint / have no grounds for
senses.example: She was excused from the swimming class on medical [[grounds]] after her ear operation.
senses.example_zh: 她耳朵動過手術後，以健康理由獲准不上游泳課。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 grounds

senses.en: to stop a plane flying or a child going out
senses.pattern: ground all flights / be grounded by fog / be grounded for a week
senses.example: All flights were [[grounded]] for six hours because of thick fog over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 由於機場上空濃霧瀰漫，所有航班停飛了六個小時。
senses.note: ground 也是 grind（磨碎）的過去式

senses.en: to listen to and judge a case in court
senses.pattern: hear a case / hear evidence / hear an appeal
senses.example: The case will be [[heard]] by three judges next month, and the public may attend.
senses.example_zh: 這起案件下個月將由三位法官審理，民眾可以旁聽。
senses.note: hearing（n.）聽證會；審訊

senses.en: the skin of a large animal, used for leather
senses.pattern: animal hides / buffalo hide / hides and furs
senses.example: Early hunters used animal [[hides]] to make warm clothes and simple tents.
senses.example_zh: 早期的獵人用獸皮製作保暖的衣物和簡單的帳篷。

senses.en: (of colors or clothes) too bright and showy
senses.pattern: a loud shirt / loud colors / a loud tie / a loud pattern
senses.example: The living room walls were painted in such [[loud]] colors that guests found it hard to relax.
senses.example_zh: 客廳的牆壁漆成十分俗豔的顏色，客人都覺得很難放鬆。

senses.en: to satisfy a need, demand, or standard
senses.pattern: meet a need / meet a demand / meet the requirements / meet a deadline
senses.example: Only two of the ten restaurants [[met]] the safety standards set by the health department.
senses.example_zh: 十家餐廳中只有兩家達到衛生局訂定的安全標準。
senses.note: 亦可指「支付」：meet the cost

senses.en: a sports competition, especially in swimming or track
senses.pattern: a track meet / a swim meet / a sports meet
senses.example: Our school's swim team broke two records at the regional [[meet]] last Saturday.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校的游泳隊上週六在區域比賽中打破兩項紀錄。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式多說 meeting

gsat.sentence: The fragrances at this scent shop are largely customized to [[meet]] the individual shopper’s taste.
Recently, new models have been introduced and accessories added to [[meet]] the needs of laborers working on various job sites.

senses.en: to avoid something unpleasant
senses.pattern: miss the traffic / miss the crowds / miss the rush hour
senses.example: We set off at five in the morning to [[miss]] the holiday traffic on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 我們清晨五點就出發，以躲過高速公路上的連假車潮。

senses.en: to fail to hit something
senses.pattern: miss the target / miss the goal / narrowly miss a tree
senses.example: The striker's powerful shot [[missed]] the goal by only a few centimeters.
senses.example_zh: 那名前鋒的強力射門只差幾公分，沒有射中球門。

senses.en: to notice that something is lost or absent
senses.pattern: miss one's wallet / not miss it until later / be missed at once
senses.example: I didn't [[miss]] my keys until I reached the front door and searched my bag.
senses.example_zh: 我直到走到大門口翻找包包，才發覺鑰匙不見了。

gsat.sentence: Because of its small size, it might have [[missed]] the other car completely.

senses.en: to wrongly think one thing is another
senses.pattern: mistake A for B / mistake salt for sugar / be mistaken for
senses.example: In the fog, the hikers [[mistook]] a large rock for a bear and ran away.
senses.example_zh: 在霧中，那些登山客把一塊大石頭誤認為熊，拔腿就跑。
senses.note: 三態：mistake–mistook–mistaken

gsat.sentence: I [[mistook]] the man for a well-known actor and asked for his autograph; it was really embarrassing.

senses.en: to care for a sick person or an injury
senses.pattern: nurse sb back to health / nurse an injury / nurse a cold
senses.example: She stayed home for a week to [[nurse]] her grandfather back to health after his surgery.
senses.example_zh: 她在家待了一週，照料手術後的祖父直到他康復。
senses.note: 亦指哺乳，如 nursing mothers

senses.en: to hold a feeling or hope for a long time
senses.pattern: nurse a grudge / nurse a hope / nurse an ambition
senses.example: For years he [[nursed]] a secret hope of becoming a pilot despite his poor eyesight.
senses.example_zh: 儘管視力不佳，多年來他一直心懷成為飛行員的祕密希望。

senses.en: about a particular subject
senses.pattern: a book on / a lecture on / advice on / a report on
senses.example: The library has just bought several new books [[on]] space travel for curious young readers.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館剛買了幾本關於太空旅行的新書，給充滿好奇心的小讀者看。
senses.note: 比 about 正式，多指專門主題

senses.en: immediately after something happens
senses.pattern: on arrival / on hearing the news / on request / on sb's return
senses.example: [[On]] hearing the fire alarm, the students lined up and walked calmly to the playground.
senses.example_zh: 一聽到火災警報，學生們就排好隊，鎮定地走到操場。
senses.note: on＋V-ing／名詞；也可用 upon

gsat.sentence: Here are some tips [[on]] choosing an ideal one from a number of colleges.
Dr. Chu’s speech [[on]] the new energy source attracted great attention from the audience at the conference.

senses.en: but; except that
senses.pattern: the same, only bigger / only it's too expensive / only I can't
senses.example: This phone looks just like mine, [[only]] the screen is slightly bigger and the case is blue.
senses.example_zh: 這支手機看起來跟我的一模一樣，只是螢幕稍大，而且外殼是藍色的。

senses.en: used to introduce a surprising or disappointing result
senses.pattern: only to find / only to discover / only to be told
senses.example: He ran all the way to the station, [[only]] to learn that the last train had left.
senses.example_zh: 他一路跑到車站，結果卻得知末班車已經開走了。
senses.note: only to + 原形動詞，表意外結果

gsat.sentence: White rhinoceroses, it turns out, do the same thing—[[only]] their choice of meeting place is a giant pile of poop.
Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—[[only]] to find the shelves almost bare and the stock nearly gone.

senses.en: one of the sides in an agreement or dispute
senses.pattern: both parties / the other party / a third party / the parties involved
senses.example: If either [[party]] breaks the agreement, the other can ask for the deposit to be returned.
senses.example_zh: 如果任何一方違反協議，另一方可以要求退還訂金。

senses.en: a group of people doing something together
senses.pattern: a search party / a rescue party / a party of four
senses.example: A rescue [[party]] of twelve climbers set out at dawn to look for the missing hikers.
senses.example_zh: 由十二名登山好手組成的搜救隊伍在黎明時出發，尋找失蹤的登山客。

gsat.sentence: Both [[parties]] can sign an agreement beforehand.
One can damage the home of the other [[party]] in return.

senses.en: a document that allows you to enter or travel
senses.pattern: a boarding pass / a bus pass / a monthly pass / a visitor's pass
senses.example: Every visitor must show a [[pass]] at the gate before entering the research center.
senses.example_zh: 每位訪客進入研究中心前，都必須在大門口出示通行證。

senses.en: a narrow route through or over mountains
senses.pattern: a mountain pass / cross a pass / a narrow pass
senses.example: Heavy snow closed the mountain [[pass]], so the truck drivers had to wait in the village.
senses.example_zh: 大雪封閉了山口，卡車司機只好在村子裡等候。

senses.en: to officially approve a law by voting
senses.pattern: pass a law / pass a bill / pass a resolution
senses.example: The city council [[passed]] a law banning smoking in all public parks and playgrounds.
senses.example_zh: 市議會通過了一項法案，禁止在所有公園和遊樂場吸菸。

senses.en: to recognize someone and remember who they are
senses.pattern: can't place sb / place a face / place sb's accent
senses.example: Her face looked familiar, but I couldn't [[place]] her until she mentioned our old piano teacher.
senses.example_zh: 她的臉很面熟，但直到她提起我們以前的鋼琴老師，我才想起她是誰。
senses.note: 多用於否定句：can't place＋人

senses.en: to make an order or arrange for an advertisement to appear
senses.pattern: place an order / place an advertisement / place a call
senses.example: Customers who [[place]] an order before noon will receive their books the following day.
senses.example_zh: 中午前下訂單的顧客隔天就會收到書。

senses.en: a position in a contest, or a chance to study
senses.pattern: take second place / win a place at a university / a place on the team
senses.example: After months of hard work, Yuki won a [[place]] at one of the country's top medical schools.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月的努力，由紀取得了全國頂尖醫學院之一的入學名額。

gsat.sentence: Although Russia does not occupy first [[place]] when it comes to alcohol consumption per capita, it is still close to the top.

senses.en: to go somewhere and say that you have arrived
senses.pattern: report to the office / report for duty / report for work
senses.example: All new students must [[report]] to the main office by eight o'clock on the first day.
senses.example_zh: 所有新生必須在開學第一天八點前到總辦公室報到。
senses.note: report for duty＝報到上班

senses.en: to tell the authorities about a crime or wrongdoing
senses.pattern: report a crime / report a theft / report someone to the police
senses.example: A neighbor [[reported]] the noisy factory to the city government after weeks of sleepless nights.
senses.example_zh: 連續幾週夜不成眠之後，一位鄰居向市政府檢舉了這家吵鬧的工廠。

senses.en: to officially take away illegal goods or property
senses.pattern: seize drugs / seize smuggled goods / seize assets
senses.example: Customs officers [[seized]] over two hundred rare turtles hidden in a traveler's suitcases.
senses.example_zh: 海關人員查扣了藏在一名旅客行李箱中的兩百多隻稀有烏龜。
senses.note: seizure（n.）沒收；奪取

senses.en: to take control of something suddenly by force
senses.pattern: seize power / seize control of / seize the city
senses.example: The rebels [[seized]] control of the capital and forced the king to leave the country.
senses.example_zh: 叛軍奪取了首都的控制權，並迫使國王離開國家。

gsat.sentence: During World War II, Japan [[seized]] much of Southeast Asia’s rubber.
This was to ensure that no single and powerful noble family could [[seize]] the title and pass it to the next generation.

senses.en: not having enough of something
senses.pattern: be short of money / be short on time / in short supply / run short of
senses.example: We are [[short]] of volunteers this year, so each of us has to work longer hours.
senses.example_zh: 今年志工人手短缺，所以我們每個人都得工作更久。

senses.en: suddenly, or before the expected end
senses.pattern: stop short / cut sth short / be cut short
senses.example: The driver stopped [[short]] when a dog ran across the road right in front of him.
senses.example_zh: 一隻狗從他正前方衝過馬路，司機突然停了下來。
senses.note: fall short of＝未達到（目標）

gsat.sentence: But fresh water can be in [[short]] supply in many arid regions of the world such as Saudi Arabia, where there are limited water resources.
Since we are [[short]] of manpower in the factory, it is very likely we will hire some people next month.

senses.en: feeling that you want to vomit
senses.pattern: feel sick / be sick to one's stomach / make someone sick
senses.example: The winding mountain road made several passengers feel [[sick]], so the driver stopped for a break.
senses.example_zh: 蜿蜒的山路讓好幾位乘客覺得想吐，司機於是停車休息。
senses.note: 英式 be sick 也指「嘔吐」

senses.en: tired of or annoyed by something
senses.pattern: be sick of / be sick and tired of / get sick of
senses.example: I am [[sick]] of hearing the same excuses every time you hand in your homework late.
senses.example_zh: 每次你遲交作業都是同一套藉口，我已經厭倦了。
senses.note: 須接 of：be sick of＋N／V-ing

gsat.sentence: Your brain’s confused reaction makes you feel [[sick]].
If you have ever been [[sick]] to your stomach on a rocking boat or a bumpy car ride, you know the discomfort of motion sickness.

senses.en: to support one person or group in an argument
senses.pattern: side with sb / side against sb / side with the majority
senses.example: To my surprise, my parents [[sided]] with my little sister in our argument over the TV.
senses.example_zh: 出乎我意料的是，在我們為了電視爭吵時，爸媽竟然支持妹妹、站在她那邊。

senses.en: one of the people or groups in an argument or contest
senses.pattern: both sides / the other side / take sides / on sb's side
senses.example: Neither [[side]] was willing to give in, so the talks ended without an agreement.
senses.example_zh: 任何一方都不願讓步，談判因此在沒有共識的情況下結束。
senses.note: take sides 選邊站

gsat.sentence: In making a case for or against zoos, both [[sides]] argue that they’re saving animals.

senses.en: having the stated number of people or members
senses.pattern: a crowd 5,000 strong / a 50-strong team / an army 10,000 strong
senses.example: A crowd ten thousand [[strong]] gathered in the square to welcome the returning athletes.
senses.example_zh: 多達一萬人的群眾聚集在廣場上，歡迎運動員凱旋歸來。
senses.note: 置於數字之後，如 a 50-strong team

senses.en: (of money or an economy) having a high value
senses.pattern: a strong dollar / a strong currency / a strong economy
senses.example: A [[strong]] dollar makes American goods more expensive for buyers in other countries.
senses.example_zh: 強勢的美元使美國商品對其他國家的買家來說變得更貴。
senses.note: 反義為 weak（疲軟的）

senses.en: a piece of candy; a sweet dish after a meal
senses.pattern: a bag of sweets / a packet of sweets / eat too many sweets
senses.example: The old shop on the corner sells handmade [[sweets]] in glass jars, just as it did fifty years ago.
senses.example_zh: 轉角那家老店用玻璃罐賣手工糖果，就和五十年前一樣。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多說 candy

senses.en: kind, gentle, and thoughtful toward other people
senses.pattern: a sweet smile / a sweet old lady / It is sweet of sb to do sth
senses.example: It was [[sweet]] of you to stay after class and help me clean the art room.
senses.example_zh: 你真貼心，下課後還留下來幫我打掃美術教室。

gsat.sentence: To tell parents what [[sweets]] are less damaging to their children’s teeth.

senses.en: a particular opinion about something
senses.pattern: one's take on / a fresh take on / What's your take on this?
senses.example: The magazine asked three scientists for their [[take]] on whether humans could live on Mars.
senses.example_zh: 這本雜誌請三位科學家談談他們對人類能否在火星居住的看法。
senses.note: 搭配介系詞 on

senses.en: to bear or accept something unpleasant
senses.pattern: can't take it anymore / take the pressure / take criticism
senses.example: Kevin quit the debate club because he could not [[take]] the constant criticism from older members.
senses.example_zh: 凱文退出辯論社，因為他無法忍受學長姐不斷的批評。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

senses.en: to consider or understand in a particular way
senses.pattern: take A for B / take sth as a compliment / I take it (that)
senses.example: Because of her youthful looks, visitors often [[take]] the principal for one of the students.
senses.example_zh: 由於校長外表年輕，訪客常誤以為她是學生。
senses.note: take A for B 把 A 誤認為 B

gsat.sentence: Sailors [[took]] the North Star as their final destination.

senses.en: to make someone feel sympathy, sadness, or gratitude
senses.pattern: be deeply touched by / touch one's heart / be touched that
senses.example: We were deeply [[touched]] by the letters that the children wrote to the firefighters.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們寫給消防員的信讓我們深受感動。
senses.note: 形容詞 touching＝感人的

senses.en: a small amount of something
senses.pattern: a touch of salt / a touch of humor / a touch of sadness
senses.example: Add a [[touch]] of lemon juice to the soup just before you serve it.
senses.example_zh: 上桌前在湯裡加少許檸檬汁。

senses.en: a small detail added to improve or complete something
senses.pattern: the finishing touches / a personal touch / a nice touch
senses.example: The artist spent the whole evening putting the finishing [[touches]] on her painting.
senses.example_zh: 那位畫家花了整個晚上為她的畫作做最後的潤飾。

senses.en: to believe something because you have been told it
senses.pattern: I understand (that) … / it is understood that … / be given to understand
senses.example: I [[understand]] from your teacher that you are planning to study abroad next year.
senses.example_zh: 我從你的老師那裡聽說，你打算明年出國念書。

senses.en: to agree on something without saying it
senses.pattern: it is understood that … / it was understood between us / be clearly understood
senses.example: It was [[understood]] that whoever got home first would start cooking, though nobody ever said so.
senses.example_zh: 雖然沒人明說，但大家都有默契：誰先到家就由誰開始煮飯。
senses.note: 常用被動 it is understood that

senses.en: to come safely through a difficult period
senses.pattern: weather the storm / weather a crisis / weather the recession
senses.example: Thanks to loyal customers, the small bookstore [[weathered]] the economic downturn and is still open today.
senses.example_zh: 多虧忠實顧客的支持，這家小書店平安度過了經濟衰退，至今仍在營業。
senses.note: weather the storm 常作比喻

senses.en: to change in color or shape through sun, wind, and rain
senses.pattern: weathered rock / a weathered face / be weathered by wind and rain
senses.example: Centuries of wind and rain have [[weathered]] the stone statues until their faces can hardly be seen.
senses.example_zh: 數百年的風吹雨打使這些石像風化，臉部幾乎已看不清楚。
senses.note: 形容詞 weathered 飽經風霜的

senses.en: (of a road or river) to curve and bend repeatedly
senses.pattern: wind through / wind along / wind its way / a winding road
senses.example: The river [[winds]] across the plain like a silver ribbon before it finally reaches the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這條河像一條銀色緞帶蜿蜒流過平原，最後注入大海。
senses.note: 讀作 /waɪnd/，過去式、過去分詞為 wound

senses.en: to wrap something around; to tighten a clock's spring
senses.pattern: wind a bandage around / wind a scarf around / wind (up) a clock
senses.example: You should [[wind]] the bandage firmly around the ankle, but not so tightly that it hurts.
senses.example_zh: 你應該把繃帶牢牢纏繞在腳踝上，但不要緊到會痛。
senses.note: 讀作 /waɪnd/

gsat.sentence: In many old castles in Europe, visitors often find a fantastic spiral staircase, which provides a captivating focal point as it [[winds]] up the building.
Throughout the Middle Ages, [[winding]] staircases became a well-established feature of European castles, mainly for their advantages in helping to defend against attackers.

quiz.stem: With the dry season lasting longer than usual, the island is running ______ of fresh water, and residents are asked to save every drop.
quiz.explain_zh: short＝短缺的。乾季拉長，島上的淡水快不夠用了。

quiz.stem: Tina expected her best friend to support her idea, but he ______ with the teacher and said the plan was too risky.
quiz.explain_zh: side＝（side with）支持。好友沒有挺蒂娜，反而站在老師那邊。

quiz.stem: From the visitor center, a narrow mountain road ______ through thick bamboo forests for ten kilometers before reaching the hot spring village.
quiz.explain_zh: wind＝蜿蜒。山路蜿蜒穿過竹林十公里後，才抵達溫泉村。

quiz.stem: The goalkeeper's quick reflexes ______ every attempt by the visiting team to score in the final ten minutes of the match.
quiz.explain_zh: frustrate＝阻撓、使落空。守門員反應快，讓客隊最後十分鐘的射門全數落空。

quiz.stem: The judge urged both ______ in the dispute to sit down and reach an agreement instead of spending more money on lawyers.
quiz.explain_zh: party＝（爭端的）一方。法官勸爭端雙方坐下來達成協議，別再花錢請律師。

quiz.stem: The committee rejected the proposal to build a new swimming pool on the ______ that it would cost far more than the school could afford.
quiz.explain_zh: ground＝理由、根據。委員會以花費遠超過學校所能負擔為由否決提案。

quiz.stem: A single moment of carelessness on the icy mountain road nearly ______ the young truck driver his life.
quiz.explain_zh: cost＝使失去。在結冰山路上一時疏忽，差點讓年輕的卡車司機喪命。

quiz.stem: The plan to build a parking tower beside the park received a ______ response from residents, most of whom wanted more green space instead.
quiz.explain_zh: cool＝冷淡的。居民多半想要綠地，對興建停車塔的計畫反應冷淡。

quiz.stem: Hikers should set up their tents on ______ ground, because sleeping on a slope or on rocks can be very uncomfortable.
quiz.explain_zh: even＝平坦的。帳篷應搭在平坦的地面上，睡在斜坡或石頭上會很不舒服。

quiz.stem: Mr. Wang usually wears plain gray suits, so his coworkers were shocked when he showed up in a ______ purple-and-orange jacket that almost hurt their eyes.
quiz.explain_zh: loud＝（顏色）俗豔的。平常穿素色西裝的王先生竟穿了刺眼的花俏外套。
